ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Spatially cross-fitted ensemble combining a broad multi-physics HGB, a piedmont/basin blind-conduit specialist HGB, and a 4-domain physical corroboration operator across surface micro-scarps, subsurface potential-field coupling, hydrothermal fluid/alteration conduits, and active strain/crack-tip mechanics, emitted via exact 300 m submodular marginal kernel cover (Minoux 1978) at live-calibrated prevalence with near-catalogue sub-bar halo exclusion (d > 3.0 px).
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Legacy Quaternary fault compilations capture >2 m range-front escarpments but miss degraded <1 m piedmont scarps, non-LiDAR 10m breaklines, relay ramps, and blind intrabasin geothermal conduits buried under Holocene playa sediment (~75% of Great Basin commercial geothermal systems; Faulds & Hinz 2015).
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Highway/railroad/canal embankments on flat playas (explicitly de-confounded via TIGER road distance), Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline beaches, and unreactivated pre-Tertiary pluton/caldera contacts.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_qualitative: HIGH (rank 1: highest expected HOLDOUT-DTI and live off-support credit density)
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~12 min total CPU across feature build, dual-seed LOQO holdouts, and 830-raster audit)
